name: Olaszfa (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, light grey, red and light grey, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Olaszfa: a crowned white shield with green leaves and a red heart, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Olaszfa arms with crown and scroll
